Markets.title: US Fed chair Kevin Warsh explains why the Federal Reserve raised interest rates
Markets.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 0.25 percent due to a strengthening US economy, resilient domestic spending, and steady job gains. The central bank took this action because inflation has stubbornly stayed above its target for years.

Markets.title: A 25 bps hike: US Federal Reserve raises interest rates for first time since 2023
Markets.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by twenty-five basis points on Wednesday to control inflation, which remained at three point four percent in August. This marks the central bank's first rate increase since 2023 and serves as a major test for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's credibility.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities rebounded on September 16, with the Sensex gaining 333 points and the Nifty rising 99 points. Large-cap stocks led the market gains while broader markets declined.

Markets.title: Sebi bars two entities over alleged cross-derivatives manipulation
Markets.summary: SEBI has banned two entities for allegedly manipulating small-cap stock prices through advanced derivatives strategies. The companies reportedly used intentional losses in stock futures to unfairly influence options prices for profit.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: PVR Inox, Radico Khaitan among 5 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities rose due to lower crude prices, softer Japanese bond yields, and expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike. Analysts recommended Policybazaar, PNB, PVR Inox, Radico Khaitan, and Hindalco based on bullish technical setups.

Markets.title: Morgan Stanley shifts $10 billion in municipal bond mutual funds to ETFs
Markets.summary: Morgan Stanley is converting eight municipal bond mutual funds holding nearly $10 billion in assets into seven new exchange-traded funds. The firm is making this move to meet strong client demand and retain assets by offering greater tax effectiveness and flexibility.

Geo-Political.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Following a breakdown in relations with the United States under President Donald Trump, Canada is seeking closer ties with the European Union. In response, the EU chief has backed a proposal for Canada to become an associate member.

Geo-Political.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
Geo-Political.summary: New photos obtained by CBS News show widespread damage to United States sites resulting from Iranian attacks. The images reveal a wrecked air force plane and several destroyed buildings.

Geo-Political.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
Geo-Political.summary: A war-damaged, six-storey building collapsed in Gaza City, killing 21 people, including eight children. The structure had been previously hit by an Israeli strike last year and was housing about 10 families.

Geo-Political.title: US accuses Russia of trying to kill Ukrainian allies overseas
Geo-Political.summary: The FBI has accused five men of conspiring to intimidate, threaten, or murder Ukrainian allies on U.S. soil and internationally. The United States has directly blamed Russia for attempting to orchestrate these overseas assassination plots.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged that public fears regarding the threats of artificial intelligence are justified. However, he and other tech executives argued that the world should trust AI companies because there are existing incentives to limit dangerous advancements.

Geo-Political.title: Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future
Geo-Political.summary: Eight German state premiers from the Christian Democratic Union have expressed support for leader Friedrich Merz amid political speculation. This backing comes as the party prepares for two crucial state elections this weekend.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An experiment using ChatGPT revealed that a WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result without any paid advertising. This discovery highlights the growing shift toward AI optimization (AIO) alongside traditional SEO for generating organic traffic.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to help digital creators improve their workflows in 2025. It explains how these technologies are revolutionizing the content creation landscape to make the process easier and more efficient.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workplace productivity. These widely used market solutions drive innovation and efficiency across various industry applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audience. Because numerous tools are available on the market, choosing the right one for your specific needs can be challenging.

Data & Insights.title: US Fed raises interest rates as Kevin Warsh bucks Donald Trump to control inflation
Data & Insights.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points to a range of 3.75% to 4.00% in a unanimous decision led by Chair Kevin Warsh. The FOMC plans to implement at least one more rate hike later this year to help control inflation.

Data & Insights.title: India clears 642 UK car imports under FTA tariff quota as first allocations roll out
Data & Insights.summary: India approved the import of 642 UK-origin cars under the tariff-rate quota provisions of the India-UK trade pact. Seven of the eight applicants received quotas, with concessional duties set to eventually decrease to 10%.

Data & Insights.title: EPFO ceiling reset after 12 years;  ₹25,000 threshold to cover 5.1 million more workers
Data & Insights.summary: The EPFO wage ceiling has increased for the first time in 12 years to ₹25,000, expanding mandatory social-security coverage to an additional 5.1 million workers. This change will also raise contribution costs for both employers and the affected employees.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: New Zealand clears path for trade deal –  What it means?
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's parliament has approved the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement, moving the trade deal closer to implementation. The agreement covers trade in goods and services, investment, agriculture, mobility, and customs procedures for both nations.

Data & Insights.title: New Zealand Parliament passes legislation to implement India FTA
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's Parliament has passed legislation to implement a free trade agreement with India. The landmark deal is expected to take effect in the second half of October, providing immediate duty-free access for more than half of New Zealand's exports.

Data & Insights.title: It's a fake! Forged art floods Indian market as masterworks fetch record millions
Data & Insights.summary: As the value of Indian art surges, the market is facing a growing flood of forgeries targeting renowned artists like MF Husain. In response to this threat, experts are urging increased authentication efforts and careful verification of artwork provenance for buyers.

India.title: In 2025, J&K Saw No Stone-Throwing Incidents, Only 1 Terrorist Recruited
India.summary: In 2025, Jammu and Kashmir recorded zero stone-throwing incidents and only one terrorist recruitment. The Defence Ministry attributed this decline to local youth abandoning violence in favor of government welfare and employment schemes.

India.title: 6 Minors Drown In Lake Near Hyderabad During Ganesh Idol Immersion
India.summary: Six boys staying at a charitable trust hostel drowned in a lake near Hyderabad. The tragedy occurred while the minors were participating in a Ganesh idol immersion.

India.title: "We Are Very Liberal": Supreme Court On Bail Cases Involving Marijuana
India.summary: The Supreme Court stated that it is very liberal regarding bail cases involving marijuana. The bench advised that accused individuals can approach the top court for bail after lower courts reject their pleas.

India.title: Centre Asks Ola, Uber, Rapido To Do Away With Advance Tipping Option
India.summary: The central government has directed ride-hailing services Ola, Uber, and Rapido to remove the option for advance tipping. The Central Consumer Protection Authority emphasized that tipping must remain voluntary and at the consumer's discretion after a ride is completed.

India.title: Revanth Reddy Orders Probe Into Farmhouse Linked To KCR, His Party Hits Back
India.summary: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy ordered an investigation into a farmhouse linked to opposition leader KCR. In response, BRS leader T Harish Rao alleged that Reddy's family collectively owns about 308 acres of land.

India.title: Will Fake Paneer Sale Be Banned Across India? Food Body Chief Explains
India.summary: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India CEO G. Kamala Vardhana Rao explained that fake paneer is not sold everywhere, as most food inspections find products to be acceptable. He noted that only the minority of cases involving actual violations receive media attention.

General.title: Body found in search for missing three-year-old Noah Woods
General.summary: Police divers discovered the body of missing three-year-old Noah Woods in a pond. He had gone missing from a playground on Tuesday.

General.title: Charles said Diana would be forgotten 'soon enough', Earl Spencer claims in book
General.summary: Earl Spencer claims in a new book that then-Prince Charles said Diana would be forgotten "soon enough" after her death. Buckingham Palace disputed this claim, stating that grief can alter people's memories of past events.

General.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
General.summary: Canada is seeking closer ties with the European Union following a breakdown in relations with the United States under President Donald Trump. The EU chief has backed a proposal for Canada to become an associate member of the bloc.

General.title: 'Putney pusher' suspect found dead at home
General.summary: Nicholas Brandram, a suspect in the 2015 "Putney pusher" incident where a woman was shoved into the path of a bus, has been found dead at his home. Police confirmed his death following the unsolved attack that occurred nine years ago.

General.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
General.summary: A wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings are among the images obtained by the BBC's partner CBS News.

General.title: Watch: BBC crew catch thieves in act while filming shoplifting report
General.summary: A BBC television crew accidentally filmed two thieves stealing items from a store while reporting on rising shoplifting rates. The journalists captured the crime in progress and subsequently reported the incident to the store staff.
